decisions: WORLD BOOTSTRAP RESOLVED (session, record as a STATE-D6 dated amendment or new record per numbering): vmMain's GAME_INIT arm constructs the zeroed GameWorld and writes it into the WorldCell BEFORE falling into the generic dispatch path — storage creation mirrors C's static allocation at load time; the dispatched GAME_INIT handler then does G_InitGame's init logic against it. GAME_SHUTDOWN's arm takes the world OUT of the cell after its dispatch returns (module-unload lifetime; map_restart's fresh GAME_INIT builds a fresh world). Fix the frozen vmMain sketch accordingly (no unconditional expect on first call).

DISPATCH RECEIVER RESOLVED (session): Dispatch<C> is implemented on a copyable pub struct WorldPtr(pub *mut GameWorld) defined in mp_game — NOT on GameWorld. &self on the copyable wrapper matches SEAM-D8's frozen trait signature (engine-seam.md is being cross-ref-amended, no trait change); impl bodies do the STATE-D6 leaf &mut reborrows internally and drop any live &mut before trap:: calls that can re-enter. This is porting-rules §17's arena/copyable-borrow-wrapper idiom. Freeze WorldPtr's shape + the impl pattern in ## Seam definition.

ZEROED CONSTRUCTION RESOLVED (session): one helper pub fn zeroed_box<T>() -> Box<T> (alloc_zeroed + Box::from_raw) in crates/native/platform is THE sanctioned construction idiom for large #[repr(C)] all-zeroes-valid types — the Rust mirror of C static zero-initialization; heap-direct (no stack transit of the ~1.83MB gentity array). Safety contract stated once at the helper (T is #[repr(C)], all-zero bit pattern valid). GameWorld::zeroed() builds Box<[gentity_t; MAX_GENTITIES]>, Box<[gclient_t; MAX_CLIENTS]>, level_locals_t via it, then wires level.gentities/clients per the existing construction-order note. Cite the helper's home; note it is Raven-free native-tier vocabulary (no workspace-architecture change needed — no new crate/edge).

REGISTRY ATTACHMENT RESOLVED (session, shared with lifecycle.md LIFE-Q5): ModuleRegistry is a field of Common — Engine.common.modules — mirroring Raven's vmTable as a qcommon-subsystem static (vm.cpp). Engine's frozen five-field shape is unchanged. Add the master-table row (mp_engine_qcommon::Common.modules, constructed empty at Com_Init step 30).

COM_PRINTF STATE (session, shared with lifecycle.md — record the state-ownership side): com_printf(common: &mut Common, msg) lives in mp_engine_qcommon; Common owns the print-adjacent state (console buffer, logfile handle, rd_buffer redirect fields).
